title: Father's rooming house, shoeshine stand and business plans
summary: His father tried to interest him in business with real estate, a rooming house, barbershop and shoeshine stand, which folded when Joe left.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: But that still didn't make me want to get into music. You know, it was more fun out playing in the streets, you know. And my father tried to interest me in business. In other words, he had a lot of real estate and he had... See, the railroad track used to be down...the Pennsylvania Railroad, where they used to switch the trains. And he had this rooming house outside of the rail station, and the guys that worked on the railroad used to stay upstairs, you know. Then there was a barber-shop next to that. So he had a little space in there between that, and then he bought us... We had a shoeshine stand. We also had the equipment to clean hats, you know. Just trying to get a start in the business, you know. And that lasted awhile until Joe went away, and then it went by the boards. And I stayed there a little while, but I wasn't good at it. Joe was but I wasn't, you know. So that folded up.
